A Damascus recipe, a Dubai welcome

Set Al Sham carries the name and the flavours of a Syrian kitchen that opened in 1963. Our chefs carve shawarma fresh from the spit and wrap it warm, then send out mezze, grills and rice dishes the way they are served at home.

Inside, hand-painted murals, tiled counters and soft lights make it an easy place to sit down with family and friends. Dine in, take away or have it delivered.
